info.title: AgriVision_Ai Inference API
info.description: Inference backend for AgriVision_Ai: EfficientNet-B0 crop disease classification with Grad-CAM explainability.

get.description: Confirms the backend process is up. Does not check model readiness -- see /health for that.
Reports whether the model is loaded, which device it's running on, and CUDA availability.
The model's class list, supported report languages, and upload limits, so a client can build its UI and validate input without hardcoding any of them.

post.summary: Diagnose a crop disease from a leaf image
post.description:
Accepts a single leaf image (multipart/form-data), runs it through the EfficientNet-B0 classifier, and returns the top prediction, a ranked top-K list, and a Grad-CAM heatmap explaining which regions of the leaf drove the prediction.

Pass `?include_report=true` to also generate the farmer-friendly LLM report in the same round trip. If report generation fails, the prediction is still returned, with the reason in `report_error`.

post.summary: Generate a farmer-friendly report for a prediction
post.description:
Turns a classifier prediction into a plain-language report: what the disease is, how urgent it is, organic and chemical treatment options, prevention, and an honest confidence caveat.

When the prediction's confidence falls below the configured threshold, the response is deliberately non-definitive: `is_low_confidence` is set, `possible_alternatives` lists the other candidates, and the report asks for a better photo instead of naming a disease. The classifier is far less accurate on real field photos than on lab images, so a confident-sounding report on a weak prediction would be actively misleading.

post.summary: Record whether a diagnosis was correct
post.description: Stores the user's verdict (yes / no / unsure) on a prediction, optionally with the class they believe is correct. The prediction is sent back by value, since /predict keeps no record of what it returned. No image is stored.

PredictWithReportResponse.title: PredictWithReportResponse
PredictWithReportResponse.description:
Response for POST /predict, extended with the optional report.

Both added fields default to None and the route sets
`response_model_exclude_none=True`, so a plain /predict call returns exactly
the body it did before this layer existed.

ReportSchema.title: ReportSchema
ReportSchema.description:
The farmer-facing report. Every field here is produced by the LLM except
`is_low_confidence` and `possible_alternatives`, which the server stamps.

example.confidence_note: The model was highly confident, but confirm the symptoms above before treating.
prevention: Avoid overhead watering late in the day
Rotate to a non-tomato, non-potato crop next season
example.severity_reason: Late blight can destroy an entire tomato crop within one to two weeks.
example.summary: A fast-spreading fungal disease that rots leaves and fruit in cool, wet weather.
symptoms_to_check: Dark brown patches on leaves, often with a pale green edge
White fuzzy growth on the underside of leaves in humid mornings

chemical: Copper-based protectant sprays are commonly used for this disease
organic: Remove and destroy affected leaves and fruit away from the field
Improve airflow by widening spacing between plants

example.when_to_consult_expert: Contact your local agricultural extension officer before applying any chemical spray, and immediately if more than a few plants are affected.
